verdict.rationale: Auth0's Token Vault is documented as obtaining, storing and refreshing third-party API tokens for Google, Slack and GitHub, among 30+ integrations. This lets agents call third-party APIs without handling credentials directly, alongside OAuth-based delegated access on the user's behalf and CIBA approval for sensitive operations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the user-consent and token-exchange mechanics and of short token lifetimes, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that Token Vault works as claimed.
